title: Dead by Daylight

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Behaviour Interactive build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Dead by Daylight as a live-service asymmetric multiplayer digital holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Behaviour Interactive online services.
preservation.concerns: Live-service multiplayer structure creates high preservation risk: chapter DLC rotation, server dependency, and account authentication. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam release dated June 14, 2016. Live chapters revise the licensed client in place; this accession records the account-bound digital edition in custody.
preservation.availability: Held as a permanent digital license on the archive Steam account while that custody and the required online services continue.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
